limits: All provider responses are substituted and audio is muted. No live ElevenLabs delivery, billing, audible pronunciation or listener comprehension is claimed.
The process kill establishes restart behavior after dispatch reservation, not machine power-loss durability.
MediaSession callback cases exercise the actual registered handlers, not physical hardware controls.
Service module reload is complemented by native fresh-process restart; neither alone is described as an OS-wide compatibility result.
The screenshot is a native app-content capture at1280x720/100%, not desktop-context presentation acceptance.
No deferred viewport or zoom checks ran.
fixtureCorrections: The first native run selected hidden Predefined-tab sample text. The final run scopes the visible sample label.
The second run reacquired the Playwright process handle after killing the app. The final run stores the actual child handle before SIGKILL and waits for that same handle to exit.
Both issues were in the acceptance driver; no production correction is claimed.
